name: Card support triage
description: Route card-support messages to one queue. Examples are a subset of PolyAI BANKING77 (CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/PolyAI-LDN/task-specific-datasets).
system_prompt: Which card-support queue should handle this customer message?
guidelines: Choose the queue for the customer's main problem.

criteria.card_arrival: new card has not arrived or asking about delivery status
criteria.card_not_working: card is physically broken or does not work at all
criteria.lost_or_stolen: customer lost their card or it was stolen
criteria.payment_declined: a card payment was declined or rejected
criteria.unrecognised_payment: customer does not recognise a card payment on their statement
criteria.compromised_card: card details may have been exposed, hacked or used fraudulently
